scope: Manual follow-up to the September 28 maintenance. CN/EN/KO official news lists, latest Korean Cafe notices and recent official X posts inspected; not an exhaustive game inventory.

sources.titleOriginal: Dragoncarp Blaze — October 4 Draw Shop announcement
sources.verificationNote: Read the official post and inspected its playing video in the browser. Explicitly identifies Mortal Rope Dart VFX Dragoncarp Blaze, October 4 at 05:00 UTC+8, Draw Shop. The unique introductory verse and goldfish flame effects match the CN named section for 鱼龙焰舞. Global cost and end date are unstated.

sources.publisher: 연운 / GM 연지 (official Korean Naver Cafe)
sources.titleOriginal: 🔥 불꽃을 따라 피어나는 어룡의 기세! 「어룡의 불꽃」 무술 이펙트, 10월 4일 공명 상점 출시
sources.verificationNote: Read the GM notice body and inspected its video poster in the browser. It explicitly names 속세의 지혜, 어룡의 불꽃, October 4 06:00 and 공명 상점. Its timezone is unstated; the EN official post supplies 05:00 UTC+8, equivalent to 06:00 KST. Introductory verse and effect visuals match the CN record.

sources.publisher: 연운 / GM 연지 (official Korean Naver Cafe)
sources.titleOriginal: 강호가 함께 경축! 출석하고 가을맞이 선물 받아가세요
sources.verificationNote: Read the GM notice in the browser. The accessory is explicitly named 서운 장식. Matched to Cloudgrace Earrings by the same September 25–October 10 event, ten login days and the two melody rewards in the official English post. Korean notice does not state a timezone; English specifies UTC. Individual accessory payout day remains unstated. The scenery poster is not an accessory reference photo.
